name: ALL OUT
source:
Haruka hooks up with Rin at training camp. 
Fr**! Iwat*bi Swim Club super hot boys love. 

Depending on "Haruka's actions", Haruka will be uke or seme. 
Couplings can be Makoto x Haruka, Haruka x Rin... tee hee.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125116.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
集训期间，遥和凛走到了一起。这是一部以《Fr○○!》岩○游泳社为题材的火热男孩恋爱故事。

视“遥的行动”而定，他既可以是受，也可以是攻。配对也可能是真琴×遥、遥×凛…嘿嘿。
